description: Anonymised natural customer phrasing mapped to technical transmission terms for user-first copy

vocabulary_mappings.customer_phrase: Bangs into gear when I stop at lights
vocabulary_mappings.technical_equivalent: Harsh 2-1 hydraulic downshift thud / sticking valve body solenoid

vocabulary_mappings.customer_phrase: Revs up on hills but the car doesn't go any faster
vocabulary_mappings.technical_equivalent: Clutch friction disc slippage / torque converter lock-up clutch slip
Transmission Control Module failsafe / mechatronic DTC logged

vocabulary_mappings.customer_phrase: Feels like driving over rumble strips at 50 mph
vocabulary_mappings.technical_equivalent: Torque converter lock-up clutch shudder under light load

vocabulary_mappings.customer_phrase: Shakes like a learner driver releasing the clutch too fast
vocabulary_mappings.technical_equivalent: Low-speed dual-clutch friction judder / dual-mass flywheel free play

vocabulary_mappings.customer_phrase: Gear stick feels like a wooden spoon in an empty bowl
vocabulary_mappings.technical_equivalent: Disconnected selector cable / perished shifter pivot bushing

vocabulary_mappings.customer_phrase: Car won't go in reverse in the morning
vocabulary_mappings.technical_equivalent: Cold hydraulic pressure loss / reverse shift actuator piston seal bypass
